The Lantern Keeper

by A Test Author


*** START OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK THE LANTERN KEEPER ***


This edition was prepared for testing Noema's literature adapter.


CHAPTER I.
The Harbour

The lantern keeper woke before the gulls did, as she had every
morning for thirty years, and climbed the stair without counting
the steps.

Below her the harbour was still the colour of slate. A single boat
had already gone out.


CHAPTER II.
The Storm

By noon the sky had closed over the water like a shutter.

She trimmed the wick, and waited, and did not think about the boat
that had gone out that morning.

When the light finally caught, it threw her shadow forty feet across
the rocks.


*** END OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK THE LANTERN KEEPER ***

This trailing licence boilerplate must not be ingested.
